links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to cardiology, oncology and psoriasis questions on four readability scales
links.effect: Flesch Reading Ease 16.3 (Chatbot D) to 39.8 (Chatbot A); Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 12.5 to 15.9; Gunning Fog 15.77 to 19.73; Dale-Chall 10.3 to 11.9, all difficult college-level text.
links.quote: The Flesch Reading Ease Scale ranged from 16.3 (12.2 - 21.9) (Chatbot D) to 39.8 (29.0 - 50.4) (Chatbot A).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the accuracy and readability of several LLM chatbots across clinical specialties without testing an organizational deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
